description: RANK of the names that won back the most of a sector-wide slump, fastest: per sector fund (and semis), the last slump's dates and depth, then its top rebounders, on settled closes. For trailing leaders use get_year_clock.

episodes.description: 'latest' (default) = each group's latest slump that ranked names, plus the current one when it differs (still falling, or not sector-wide); 'all' = every slump in the one-year window.

group.description: One group by its fund: SMH (Semiconductors) or a sector fund. Omit for every group.

include_history.description: Include the ~30-point [unix_seconds, close] path of each leader and fund. Default false.

min_market_cap.description: Minimum market cap in USD dollars. Default and floor 2e9 ($2B); 1e10 keeps the $10B+ names. Boards are stored at these two floors only: any other value serves the stored rows that clear it and is flagged in `incomplete`.

top.description: Most leaders per slump. Default 5. Boards store 10 (the top 10 overall, plus the top 10 at $10B+); a larger top is flagged in `incomplete`.

name: get_top_bounce
